name: Adam C. Carranza
office: Mountain View School District, Governing Board Member

items.text: Adam Carranza is vice president of the Mountain View School District board, first elected in 2009. He holds a master's degree in public administration from California State University, Los Angeles and a bachelor's degree in speech communication from the University of La Verne. He works as a substitute teacher for students in kindergarten through 12th grade. On the board, he has focused on addressing the needs of English language learners and building parent engagement programs.
